title: Chicago Highlights Running Tour
includes: Live, in person, running tour guide
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us for the most memorable experience you will have while visiting Chicago! For runners from around the world, this is definitely a “bucket list” activity. This casual paced, guided running tour will take you through and around the most iconic sights that Chicago has to offer. We will take you along the Lake Michigan shoreline where you will take in the most spectacular views of the beautiful city skyline, through Downtown and “the Loop” to cross the Chicago River where we will share some of the incredible history that has made Chicago so famous, from gangsters to marine disasters, and finally up Michigan Avenue to enjoy the cultural and architectural highlights of the Chicago Art Institute, famous historical building and so much more! You will not break any personal best running times, though, as we make stops along the way to talk about the sights and take pictures for you to share with friends and loved ones!
